correctness.rationale: The four Venn-cell nonemptiness bits determine all inclusion and Some sentences. The comparison signs of u=b-c, v=a-d, u+v and v-u determine every pairwise noun-cardinality comparison. Rescaling their two magnitudes to 0,1,2 according to signs and relative order preserves all four signs, and reconstructing each of two count pairs with the original positivity pattern yields size <= 4+|u'|+|v'| <= 7. This applies to infinite theories. Jiang’s independently stated global tail/even-tail classification limits possibilities to eleven. Explicit theories attain all eleven spectra, with a seven-point T7 witness and extension arguments for every larger admissible size. The checker exhaustively corroborates 82,250 instances but is not treated as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A natural vocabulary-restriction question is quantitatively unresolved by the unrestricted Jiang theorem: does bounding noun resources bound minimal model sizes and which spectra survive? This result gives a complete exact 11-spectrum classification, sharp universal compression to seven points across even infinite theories, and explicit extremizers. It extends a public one-variable five-spectrum classification and distinguishes bounded vocabulary from unbounded spectral thresholds. The result is useful for finite-model search bounds and expressiveness comparisons, beyond a routine small corollary.
